Q4_0/Q6_K layouts and decoding follow ggml, with MIT notice in ggml-LICENSE. LFM layer semantics were checked against llama.cpp 956973c76466b6c791d7bdbe6eed3aa3235b2dc1. Model weights are separately licensed by Liquid AI and are not included in Git.

The LCD ASCII font is the public-domain font8x8_basic by Daniel Hepper, based on public-domain VGA glyphs. Original notice is preserved in firmware/main/font8x8.h. Source: https://github.com/dhepper/font8x8 . Unicode text is rasterized using the Mac system fonts at runtime; font files are not redistributed.
